milestones.title: Sprint 1 - Data and model
milestones.description: Goal: PCam prepared reproducibly, a TensorFlow classifier trained on GPU, evaluated once on the held-out test split with calibration, and exported to ONNX with a parity check.

milestones.title: Sprint 2 - Rust inference service
milestones.description: Goal: an authenticated Rust (axum + ONNX Runtime) service with dynamic batching, patch and tile endpoints, metrics, and a measured comparison with a Python baseline.

milestones.title: Sprint 3 - JavaScript viewer and client
milestones.description: Goal: a plain-JavaScript slide viewer that shows tumour heatmaps from the service, a JavaScript client library with tests, and end-to-end tests.

milestones.title: Sprint 4 - Release
milestones.description: Goal: one-command stack, load tests, Terraform for Cloud Run, CI green, README and model card.

milestones.title: Backlog
milestones.description: Not scheduled: work that needs an account or a later sprint.

issues.title: Repository scaffold: Cargo workspace, Python training project, JS packages, CI skeleton
issues.body:
As a contributor, I want the three toolchains (cargo, uv, npm) set up with lint and test commands and a CI that runs them, so that every push is checked.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] `cargo fmt/clippy/test`, `ruff/mypy/pytest`, `eslint/vitest` all run in CI
- [ ] secret scan before every push and in CI

issues.title: Prepare PCam reproducibly with checksums
issues.body:
As an ML engineer, I want a script that downloads the PatchCamelyon files, checks them and converts them to memory-mapped arrays, so that training reads 262,144 patches fast and anyone can rebuild them.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] counts and label balance per split verified against the published numbers
- [ ] train/valid/test kept exactly as published (no reshuffling)

issues.title: Train a TensorFlow classifier on GPU
issues.body:
As a pathologist's tool, I want a patch classifier for lymph-node metastasis trained with stain and geometric augmentation, so that tumour regions can be flagged.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] training runs in a pinned TensorFlow GPU container
- [ ] early stopping on the validation split only

issues.title: Held-out evaluation, calibration and test-time augmentation
issues.body:
As a clinical reviewer, I want AUC, accuracy, sensitivity at a fixed specificity and calibration on the untouched test split, with bootstrap confidence intervals, so that I know how far to trust a score.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] temperature scaling fitted on validation only
- [ ] effect of 8-way test-time augmentation measured
- [ ] `reports/metrics.json` committed

issues.title: Export to ONNX with a parity check
issues.body:
As a service owner, I want the model as ONNX with its maximum difference from TensorFlow measured, so that the Rust service runs the same model.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] max absolute probability difference on the test split recorded

issues.title: Rust service: patch classification endpoint
issues.body:
As a client application, I want to POST image patches and get probabilities, so that I can score patches without Python.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] axum + ONNX Runtime, preprocessing identical to training (tested on fixtures)
- [ ] API keys, body and image-size limits, structured errors

issues.title: Dynamic batching
issues.body:
As an operator, I want concurrent requests merged into one model call up to a size or time limit, so that throughput scales with load.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] batch size and wait configurable
- [ ] throughput with and without batching measured

issues.title: Tile heatmap endpoint
issues.body:
As a pathologist, I want a whole tile scored with a sliding window and returned as a heatmap, so that I can see where tumour is likely.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] stride configurable, tile size limited
- [ ] heatmap matches patch-by-patch scoring in a test

issues.title: Observability: metrics, JSON logs, health and readiness
issues.body:
As an operator, I want Prometheus metrics, structured logs and readiness that waits for the model, so that I can run and alert on the service.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] latency histograms, batch-size histogram, errors by kind
- [ ] alert rules with promtool tests and a Grafana dashboard

issues.title: Python baseline service and comparison
issues.body:
As a reviewer, I want the same model served by FastAPI + onnxruntime and load-tested the same way, so that the choice of Rust is backed by numbers.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] k6 at fixed rates against both, results committed

issues.title: JavaScript client library
issues.body:
As a front-end developer, I want a small JavaScript client with timeouts, retries and typed errors, so that apps call the service correctly.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] plain JavaScript (ES modules, JSDoc types checked by tsc), no runtime dependencies
- [ ] unit tests with a mocked server

issues.title: Slide viewer with tumour heatmaps
issues.body:
As a pathologist, I want to open a test slide region and see the model's heatmap over it, next to the ground-truth labels, so that I can judge the model visually.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] plain JavaScript, canvas overlay, accessible controls
- [ ] Playwright end-to-end test against the running stack

issues.title: One command to run the stack
issues.body:
As a reviewer, I want `make up` to start the service, the viewer, Prometheus and Grafana, so that I can try it in minutes.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] smoke test in CI

issues.title: Load tests at fixed rates
issues.body:
As an engineer, I want k6 results for the patch and heatmap endpoints, so that capacity and the latency SLO are measured.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] p50/p95/p99 and error rate committed per rate

issues.title: Terraform for Cloud Run
issues.body:
As a platform engineer, I want the service, the model bucket and the image repository as code, so that it can be deployed on the free tier.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] validate, tflint and trivy pass in CI; nothing applied without an account

issues.title: README, architecture, ADRs and model card
issues.body:
As a hiring manager, I want the problem, design, results and limits on one page.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] every number links to a committed result file

issues.title: Deploy to Cloud Run once a GCP project exists
issues.body: Blocked on the owner creating a GCP project with billing. Steps are in docs/DEPLOY.md.

issues.title: GitHub Projects board for the sprints
issues.body: The CLI token lacks the `project` scope. After `gh auth refresh -s project`, run `python scripts/agile/sync_backlog.py --board`.

issues.title: Bug: the ONNX export turns EfficientNet's normalization constants into extra graph inputs
issues.body:
Found by a one-epoch smoke run before the real training: ONNX Runtime refused to run the exported model on images alone. Three converters (tf2onnx from_keras, from_function, Keras' own ONNX export) all did it.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] the ONNX model has one input, `image`
- [ ] parity with TensorFlow is checked on real patches, batched
- [ ] a unit test exports a network and checks parity

issues.title: Choose the learning rate on the validation split only
issues.body:
The first full run peaked after one epoch and then overfitted (validation AUC 0.963 -> 0.914 by epoch 4).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] a mode that trains and scores validation without reading the test split
- [ ] the candidates' results committed, and the test split scored once for the chosen one
